'''Etceteria''' is an island kingdom in the [[Northern Ocean]], north-west off the coast of the [[Fremennik Province]]. It was formed as a colony by [[Fremennik]]s who split off from the Fremennik people of the mainland due to cultural differences a long time ago, but has since become independent.{{CiteNPC|npc=Hamal the Chieftain|quote=Oh yes... that group left the mainland a long time ago. And good riddance to them, I say.|loc=Mountain Daughter|notes=|name=}}{{CiteNews|author=RuneScape|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/throne-of-miscellania|title=Throne Of Miscellania|newsdate=29 November 2004|notes=|name=}} It lies directly east of the kingdom of [[Miscellania]].

The island kingdom is ruled by [[Queen Sigrid]], who was at war with [[King Vargas]] of the Kingdom of Miscellania. The two kingdoms have been at war (despite neither side having an army) prior to the player intervening in their politics. After the events of [[Throne of Miscellania]], peace was established between the two monarchs. Immediately after, tensions rose again primarily due to the meddling of [[Fremennik]] kids, which were found out about and resolved by the player during the events of [[Royal Trouble]].

==Transportation==
* A [[spirit tree]] can be grown in the [[spirit tree patch]] on Etceteria, provided that the relevant quest and [[Farming]] level requirements have been met to grow and use it. This is the only direct transportation to Etceteria.
* A boat found off of the second most western dock in northern [[Rellekka]] sails to and from the dock on Miscellania (requires the completion of the quest [[The Fremennik Trials]]). The player will need to travel north and then east across the bridge to reach Etceteria. Players with 55 [[Agility]] can hop across the rocks connecting the dock and southern Etceteria.
* Docking at the island with level 65 [[Sailing]] and after the completion of Royal Trouble
* There is a [[fairy ring]] (code {{Fairycode|CIP}}) to the north-west on Miscellania, which requires the completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]] in order to use.
* A charged [[ring of wealth]] can be used to teleport to Miscellania, but only once [[Throne of Miscellania]] has been completed.

==Notable features==
===Bank===
There is a [[Etceteria bank|bank]] north-east of the island.

===Etceteria courtyard===
The stalls [[Island Greengrocer]] and [[Etceteria Fish]] can be found in the courtyard of Etceteria castle, which sell a variety of fishing gear, [[raw sardine]]s, and common vegetables.

===Farming patches===
There is a [[bush patch#Bush patches|bush patch]] to the south-west of the island and a spirit tree patch to the south-east, both operating like any other patch of its type would throughout [[Gielinor]], the former being one of the only ways the player can obtain resources on their own on the island. There are nearby vegetable and flower patches, but these are only used in kingdom management; players cannot grow or collect their own crops from them.

===Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon===
{{Main|Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon}}
There is an entrance to the [[Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon]] behind the castle, close to the spirit tree patch. This side of the dungeon is occupied by many [[sea snake hatchling]]s and [[sea snake young]]s.

==Managing your kingdom==
{{main|Managing Miscellania}}
Once the quest [[Royal Trouble]] has been completed, the Kingdom of Etceteria also begins working for the player.

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Etceteria with level 65 [[Sailing]], provided they have also completed [[Royal Trouble]]. The dock south-east of the castle offers the following utilities for sailors, though many are unusable until the quest is completed:
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

==Treasure Trails==
[[File:Cryptic clue - dig etceteria.png|thumb|The spot to dig for the clue.]]
Digging next to the [[evergreen tree]] in front of the castle walls is the solution to the hard [[cryptic clue]]: ''And so on, and so on, and so on. Walking from the land of many unimportant things leads to a choice of paths.''

==Trivia==
*The name "Etceteria" is a play on the phrase "et cetera".
*The dungeon entrance prevents players from walking around the outside of the castle along its eastern wall. Players who are walking from the north can bypass this by entering the dungeon and immediately leaving it, as they will reappear south of the entrance. Players wishing to walk in the other direction cannot use this trick as exiting the dungeon '''always''' places the player on the south side of the entrance.
*In [[Throne of Miscellania]], King Vargas claims Miscellania has been at war with Etceteria for hundreds of years, whereas Princess Astrid claims the war was started more recently after being insulted by Queen Sigrid of Etceteria. It is likely that King Vargas was exaggerating, as [[Hamal the Chieftain]]'s dialogue when Miscellania is brought up to him suggests that he was alive at the time Fremennik colonies were formed on the two islands, indicating that it's not possible for them to have been at war for hundreds of years.
**However, the [[burnt diary]] in [[Royal Trouble]] suggests those living on the mainland do believe the two kingdoms have been at war for hundreds of years, suggesting that King Vargas may not have been exaggerating.
